fusions.name: Chilled Spit
fusions.desc: Spits chilled water that deals 4 damage with a 30% chance to leave the target [Hindered] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Dawn Chill
fusions.desc: Breathes cold air in a cone 5 tiles long, dealing 11 damage to everything in it and knocking it back 2 tiles. Each hit has a 60% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Utter Stillness
fusions.desc: Holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Sun Bath
fusions.desc: In daylight, you deal 12% more damage. Your abilities' cooldowns are 5% shorter at all times.
